* '''PC-E2''' ([[Grogu In Razor Crest (Errata 2)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 27 release sheet<ref name="sheet27-20261013">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-27.pdf Virtual Set 27 release sheet] (PDF, 6 pages; publisher edition line “SWCCG Players Committee, October 2026”).</ref>, page 6, October 2026 edition: “May add 1 pilot and 1 passenger. Permanent pilot is •Grogu, who provides ability of 4. Unless opponent has total ability &gt; 6 piloting here, reset opponent's total battle destiny here to 0.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Grogu In Razor Crest (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Grogu In Razor Crest (Errata)]] (repository revision dated 11 October 2026) as a printable slip under the label “•Grogu In Razor Crest”; the printed game text matches the card image.  '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 2 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
